Three.js is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2020.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1).

Most recently: [ctu-cz](@/work/ctu-cz.md): Otevrena data ceskeho telekomunikacniho uradu; [maze](@/work/maze.md): Maze Web Application.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Three.js: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Three.js to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
